name: BU-LAD
summary: BU-LAD, also known as 6-butyl-6-nor-LSD or 6-butyl-6-nor-lysergic acid diethylamide, is a psychedelic drug and analogue of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) first described by David E. Nichols and colleagues in the 1980s.

pharmacology.text: BU-LAD substitutes for LSD in rodent drug discrimination tests. However, it has 13-fold reduced potency relative to LSD itself and 37- to 42-fold lower potency than ETH-LAD and AL-LAD in this test.

summaryZh: BU-LAD是一種有機化合物，化學式為C23H31N3O，為迷幻藥物麥角酸二乙醯胺的同系物，最早由亞歷山大·舒爾金在其著作《TiHKAL：延續》中提出。
